# Kazakhstan Automobile Union (KAO)

> > Official website of the Kazakhstan Automobile Union, representing the automotive industry and promoting vehicle production localization in Kazakhstan.

KAO serves as the primary industry association for Kazakhstan's automotive sector, providing market analysis, production statistics, and advocacy for fleet renewal and domestic manufacturing. The organization works with major players like Astana Motors and international partners from South Korea and the U.S. to develop the local auto industry.

## Key Topics

- Kazakhstan automotive industry
- Astana Motors
- Fleet renewal programs
- Vehicle production localization
- Domestic manufacturing
- Market analysis and statistics
- Industry association advocacy
- South Korea partnerships
- Kazakhstan auto market trends
- Production statistics
- Astana business hub
- Market results reporting
- Local assembly operations
- Industry team: Dilnaz Meirambekova, Eldana Aitimbetova, Ilyas Alzhanov
